subject.size_in_frame: back to the sh068 close across the hall — her face high and partly cropped, about 0.30 of frame height

headroom: none, as before; the return to this frame after the wide of sh071 is what makes two seconds feel like a jolt.
horizon_eyeline: Water-level axis, lens on the flagstones at 0.35 m — but the flagstone line of sh068 is now a water line at 0.84 of frame height. Her eyeline comes up for the first time since sh068, from down in her knees to level at 0.34, listening.

layers.fg: her knee and the water round it
layers.mg: her face and her hands coming away from her eyes
layers.bg: the dark hall, a distant pattering and splashing that is not yet in frame

gaze.note: the first outward look in four shots: her eyes go left, up the hall, toward a sound. The lead room opens on that side and is empty, which is what makes the next cut arrive somewhere.

balance: The sh068/sh069 crowded frame, but with the weight beginning to shift left as her attention does. Nothing else has changed, so the change of look is the whole event.
leading_lines: Her sightline is the only line in frame with a direction; everything else is the same closed wedge of knee and vault.
eye_first: Her hands leaving her eyes, then her eyes going left.
constraint_binding: The first short shot in ninety seconds — the composition returns to a frame the audience already knows so that the two seconds do not have to establish anything and can be spent entirely on the change of attention.
